name: session-progress
description: A pane for your Claude Code session: a plan bar for the current request, a history of every task with its steps and subagents, the live progress of a dev-loop orchestration run, and a pixel dragon that grows with your context window. A mod (function hooks); it reads and never writes to your project.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the locale (LC_ALL, else LANG); en or ko pins it.

openPaneOnStart.title: Open the pane on start
openPaneOnStart.description: Open the pane when an interactive session starts. Off: only /progress opens it.

reportSteps.title: Ask the model for steps
reportSteps.description: Where the session has no TodoWrite or TaskCreate, register a steps tool and add its guide to the system prompt.

summarizeTitles.title: Short titles for long prompts
summarizeTitles.description: Shorten long prompts into history titles with a small Haiku call.

showDragon.title: Context Dragon
showDragon.description: Draw the Context Dragon. Off: a one-line context gauge and no dragon animation.
